findings.claim: The receipt-schema production command example omits the required --handoff-receipt-json argument, so copying that example causes finalizer argument parsing to fail even though the supervisor lifecycle contract documents the complete command.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/finalize_receipt.py:77-85 declares --handoff-receipt-json as required and parses it before finalization.
skills/slice-supervisor/SKILL.md:126-133 provides the complete supported production command, including --handoff-receipt-json.

limitations: Review was bounded to the supplied snapshot and packet artifacts.
The 52 supervisor Python tests passed with bytecode generation disabled; Node campaign-preflight tests were not independently executed.
No claims were made about excluded mid-slice recovery, migration, limits, notifications, or reference orchestration.
Started and completed timestamps are orchestration bounds; the Codex subagent harness did not expose provider wall-clock or token measurements.
